## Change

Describe the player-visible result and why it is needed.

## Branch scope

Base branch:

- QOL: mechanics, systems and shared UI
- Havora-Development: Havora maps, gym and local content
- Sprites: character sprites, frames and palettes
- Randomizer: Pokémon, ability and move randomization mechanics
- Corvala-dev: Corvala content
- Pokemon-Quantum-V2: tested integration or cross-region campaign work

## Validation

List the checks actually run and any remaining limitation. For visual changes,
include a useful screenshot when available.
